owner_request_summary: Produce a coherent original FOULWAKE rulebook, cards and story with full-page FOULWAKE-only cover, restrained parchment/ink art, readable typography, preserved mechanics and map identities, updated canon and two combined A4 print PDFs. Review text/names, visuals and duplex alignment. Current user explicitly asks Chief Editor to execute the production.

binding_decisions.preserve: Game mechanics, all 121 card identities, established map art identity, liked single upright lighthouse, shared hidden backs, dimensions and long-edge duplex layout.
binding_decisions.reference_use: Design language only. Do not copy the attached illustrations, page compositions, reference texts or invented mechanics.
binding_decisions.production: Native typeset text; targeted artwork refinements and original book artwork. One combined cards PDF and one rulebook PDF.

chief_editor_implementation_decisions.historical_records: Do not rewrite frozen releases, past task inputs or delivery evidence. Update active source and entrypoint canon; label superseded historical guidance explicitly. Name scans distinguish current output from archived evidence.
chief_editor_implementation_decisions.review: Same-operator digital review; do not claim independent review, physical proof, human playtest, release or lock.
